nl.title: Meerdere websites op één CyberPanel-server beheren
nl.excerpt: Meerdere websites op één CyberPanel-server beheren: praktische handleiding in CyberPanel, met stappen, controles en wanneer je TripleZero iT support inschakelt.
nl.bodyHtml:
Meerdere websites op één CyberPanel-server is normaal: elk domein krijgt eigen vhost, PHP-versie en idealiter eigen gebruiker.

Best practices

  • Eén Create Website per echt project (niet alles onder één user tenzij bewust).
  • Gescheiden databases en mailboxen per site.
  • Monitor schijf/inodes — veel sites vullen sneller.
  • Updates en backups per site plannen.

Valkuilen

  • Gedeelde admin-login voor alle klanten.
  • Eén PHP-versie forceren die niet bij alle CMS’en past.
  • Vergeten SSL per nieuw domein.

Heb je na het volgen van deze stappen nog vragen? Neem contact op met TripleZero iT support via het ticketssysteem. Vermeld hostname, CyberPanel-URL en wat je precies ziet (foutmelding of screenshot).

Gerelateerd: Websitegebruikers ACL; resourcegebruik.

en.bodyHtml:
This guide covers Manage multiple websites on one CyberPanel server. You work in CyberPanel, focusing on manage, multiple, websites — not unrelated side quests in other menus.

Preparation

  • Access to CyberPanel
  • Focus of this article: manage, multiple, websites
  • Note of the current setting/status

Steps

  1. Open CyberPanel and look specifically for settings around manage, multiple, websites.
  2. Select the correct website in CyberPanel.
  3. Open SSL, DNS, Email, File Manager or Backup — focused on manage.
  4. Apply the multiple update; purge OLS cache if the site shows stale content.
  5. Check Error Logs if you get 500/white screen after the change.
  6. Document what you changed around manage, multiple, websites (old → new value) for support.

Verify

  • Result for manage, multiple, websites matches “Manage multiple websites on one CyberPanel server”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside manage multiple websites
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get manage, multiple, websites right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if manage, multiple, websites touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).
